metaDescription: About Nafas Zist Pharmed, a knowledge-based company — from research to production.
story: Nafas Zist Pharmed, a knowledge-based company, began operating in 2019 with the aim of meeting patients' needs and achieving a leading position in the pharmaceutical manufacturing industry. From the earliest days, the focus was placed on dry powder inhalation products (DPI).

After years of research and development, the company acquired pharmaceutical formulation know-how and particle aerodynamics engineering, and the manufacturing licence for its first product was issued by the Food and Drug Organization. The product Tiotoriva (tiotropium 18 micrograms) was introduced as the first mass-produced dry powder inhalation product in Iran.

Building on this achievement, the company has received “knowledge-based company, Type 1” certification from the Vice-Presidency for Science and Technology. The production of Tiotoriva not only prevents the annual outflow of more than 10 million US dollars, but has also opened export prospects to neighbouring countries.
